text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fuha, you completely blew it! You suck at 
this~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Uh, you don't have to apologize so 
seriously. I mean, to begin with, I was 
the one who wanted it..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Ah, come to think of it, my room's 
a mess. I got nowhere to put it. Maybe 
this was actually for the best~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My stomach is empty, though! Buy me ramen 
and we'll call it even, okay? Alright, 
settled! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
